notes: S2-FIX2 U7 (decision 2026-11-15 #22; §11.8, §11.9, §14.6), replacing S2-FIX1's readable-not-reported-after-zip-structure-failure: the archive has a well-formed readable/notes.txt entry and one byte of a record member's stored data is flipped, so the member's CRC-32 fails when it is read: E_CONTAINER_ZIP. Phases 1-4 of the zip check order and the entry checks passed, so the readable/ entry was observed before the member-level failure, and N_READABLE_PRESENT is reported.
